fills.researcher_notes: ONE COMPANY QUESTION for this brief (see also P2211/OPaL, P2212+P3912/GAIL, P0920/PIL, each answered once below). P2210 is a captive refinery feeder line — IOCL owns it AND is directly authorised to run it, no intervening SPV, so Owner (sheet: 'Indian Oil Corp [100.%]') and Operator are the same entity here. Primary, independent-of-GEM confirmation is the PNGRB NGPL MIS register (Aug-2024 edition; url_verifier FAILs on the large PDF, a documented false negative — confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout): the 'Operational Dedicated Natural Gas Pipelines' table names the authorised entity as 'IOCL' with authorised length 106.00 km / capacity 5.23 MMSCMD / operating length 106.0 km, matching the sheet's LengthKnownKm and Capacity exactly. NOTE: this authorisation-holder table does not itself use the word 'operator', so per the protocol's caveat about the register I am pairing it with two secondary sources that DO speak to operation: ipgprojects.com's project profile states explicitly 'Indian Oil Corporation Limited operates and owns the facility' (PMC contractor named separately as Jaihind Project Limited, i.e. a construction contractor, not the operator); nsenergybusiness.com (NS Energy/GlobalData, a different publisher) corroborates the same pipeline/length/context under an article about IOCL's own Gujarat Refinery. Indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in (checked, not cited as a proposed_ref since its operator language was only 'Central PSU' rather than naming IOCL directly) additionally corroborates project name, locations (Vadodara/Bharuch, i.e. Koyali) and a COD window of Aug 2017-Feb 2022, consistent with sheet StartYear1=2022. Direct fetch of iocl.com/gas-pipelines itself was attempted and blocked (HTTP 307 via a Sucuri WAF/bot-protection redirect loop, confirmed with both curl and url_verifier.py; Wayback Machine was also unreachable from this environment) — not used as a citation since it could not be independently verified, though a search-engine cache of that same page showed consistent text (106 km, commissioned March 2022, 5.23 MMSCMD). Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org. Value UNCHANGED (Operator was blank); ref-only addition, tier high on 2 independent non-GEM sources with the value present plus the regulator's authorisation-holder record.
